newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer says response strong on Highlands.
newsitem.headline: Placer says response strong on Highlands.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said Tuesday that was receiving a good response to its A$0.75 a share takeover offer for Highlands Gold Ltd from Highlands shareholders.
The bid is due to close Saturday.

"Obviously many Highlands shareholders like our A$0.75 a share offer,'' Placer Dome Chief Executive John Willson said. "We are encouraged by the strong level of acceptances we have received, both from small shareholders and institutions."
Placer did not say how many shares it had received so far.
Highlands board has urged its shareholders to reject the offer, saying the company was worth significantly more than Placer's bid.
Placer put its own interpretation on the board's stance.

"While the Highlands' board has stopped short of recommending Placer Dome's offer to its shareholders, it has warned shareholders that Highlands' shares could trade below the offer price when the bid closes.
"The Highlands' board has also advised shareholders with small unmarketable parcels that they may find the cash offer attractive," Willson said.
"Placer Dome believes its offer for Highlands Gold shares is demonstrably fair and reasonable," he said.
